##### Project general facts

Danah Bay is a premium beachfront residential community that combines villas, townhouses, apartments, and hospitality components within a master-planned coastal environment. Designed as a lifestyle-oriented development, the project emphasizes resort-style living with contemporary architecture, spacious residences, and a strong connection to the waterfront. The community spans a large-scale development featuring residential neighborhoods, private beachfront residences, serviced accommodations, and a hotel component. The villas and townhouses are designed with open-plan layouts, generous living spaces, expansive balconies, and direct integration with outdoor areas, while the apartments offer practical layouts with enhanced storage solutions and spacious terraces. The overall concept blends luxury residential living with the atmosphere of a private resort.

Residents have access to an extensive range of amenities designed to support leisure, wellness, recreation, and everyday convenience. The development features private beaches, landscaped parks, swimming pools, water-based recreational facilities, beachfront leisure areas, cafés, restaurants, and community spaces. Residents also benefit from hotel-style amenities, outdoor relaxation areas, and a variety of facilities that encourage an active and social lifestyle. The master plan includes extensive beachfront zones and recreational environments designed for both relaxation and outdoor activities.

The villas and townhouses feature contemporary interiors inspired by high-end beach resorts, with open-plan living, dining, and kitchen areas, statement staircases, accent stone walls, and modern materials throughout. Apartments are designed with thoughtfully planned living spaces, additional storage solutions, walk-in closets in selected units, and spacious balconies. All residences include fully equipped kitchens with appliances. Properties are delivered without furniture. The overall specification reflects modern finishing with high-quality materials and a design approach focused on comfort, functionality, and coastal-inspired living.

##### Location description and benefits 

Al Marjan Island is one of the most prestigious coastal destinations in the United Arab Emirates, offering an exceptional combination of natural beauty, modern infrastructure, and resort-style living. This purpose-built island archipelago is known for its crystal-clear waters, expansive beaches, and thoughtfully designed waterfront communities, creating an atmosphere of tranquility and exclusivity that attracts both residents and international investors.

The island benefits from proximity to one of the region’s most exciting upcoming leisure destinations, the renowned Wynn Al Marjan Island Resort. The arrival of this world-class resort and entertainment destination is expected to further elevate the island’s global profile, bringing a vibrant mix of luxury hospitality, fine dining, and premium entertainment experiences. At the same time, the surrounding emirate of Ras Al Khaimah is celebrated for its diverse natural landscapes, ranging from scenic mountain ranges to vast deserts and protected coastlines, creating a truly unique environment that blends adventure with relaxation.

Connectivity is another significant advantage of the area. The island enjoys convenient access to Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, as well as quick links to major transportation routes leading to Dubai and other key emirates. This accessibility allows residents to enjoy a peaceful seaside lifestyle while remaining closely connected to the region’s main business, cultural, and entertainment hubs. Combined with the island’s growing collection of luxury resorts, waterfront promenades, marinas, and leisure attractions, the location offers an exceptional environment for both lifestyle living and long-term investment potential.
